findings.description: The new logarithm can raise ValueError when max / multiplier underflows to zero, instead of returning the capped wait.
findings.rationale: With multiplier=1e300, max=1e-300, exp_base=2 and attempt_number=1, all preceding guards pass, but max / multiplier rounds to 0.0. math.log(0.0, 2) raises an uncaught ValueError, aborting the retry operation; the previous implementation returned 1e-300.
